 Order
(Dated this the 4th day of March, 2026) The petitioners are accused persons 2 and 3 in S.C No.164
of 2024 of Special Court for the trial of Sc/St(Poa) Act, Nedumangad, arising out of Crime
No.1342 of
2023 of Medical College Police Station, Thiruvananthapuram
. They filed this Crl.M.C under Section 528 BNSS praying for quashing all further proceedings against them.
The offences alleged against the petitioners and the co-accused are under Sections 498A and 323 of IPC and Sections 3(1)(c) and 3(2)(va) of the SC/ST(POA) Act.

2. The prosecution case is that the accused, who is not a member of scheduled caste or scheduled tribe, married the de facto complainant, who was a member of the scheduled caste community and thereafter, he along with the petitioners subjected her to cruelty both physically and mentally on the ground of dowry.
It is also alleged that the 1 st accused voluntarily caused hurt to her.

Indiradevi vs State Of Kerala on 4 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25251831/
2

3. According to the learned Senior Counsel, who is appearing for the petitioners, even if the entire allegations levelled against the petitioners as such is believed, the same will not constitute the offences as alleged.
Therefore, he prayed for 2026:KER:19399 quashing all further proceedings against the petitioners.
4. The petition was strongly opposed by the learned counsel for the 2nd respondent/de facto complainant as well as by the learned Public Prosecutor.

5. On a perusal of the FI statement, it can be seen that, though there are several allegations against the accused persons in general, there is no specific allegations with material particulars like date as against the petitioners.
6. In the above circumstances, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the proceedings against the petitioners, as the same will only be an abuse of the process of the Court.
Therefore, this Crl. M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioners in S.C No.164 of 2024 of Special Court for the trial of SC/ST(POA) Act, Nedumangad, arising out of Crime No.1342 of 2023 of Medical College Police Station, Thiruvananthapuram, is quashed under Section 528 of B.N.S.S. Sd/-
C. Annexure 2
THE CERTIFIED COPY OF THE FIR AND FIS IN CRIME NO.1342/2023 OF MEDICAL COLLEGE POLICE STATION, THIRUVANANTHAPURAM DISTRICT.
